outcome.technical: tools/lints/_deps.py: (a) _scope_normalisers(scope) builds {local: normalisers} in one walk; _name_normalisers is a lookup in it; _scope_config_reads(..., index=None) builds the index for the scope it was handed and looks up locals in it. (b) _loader_facts(tree, siblings) holds module/function loader names, own wrappers, sibling aliases and borrow candidates once per parsed file; _borrowed_from_facts answers _borrowed_wrapper_names from them; _wrapper_map(trees, facts=None) and _runtime_loaded_sibling_names(..., facts=None) read them; _scan_edges_once takes facts per parsed tree (a basename collision keeps each copy's own facts). (c) _literal_index(tree) gives doc ids, label ids and string nodes in walk order from one walk; the three readers take (text, index=None) and keep the text form; register_citation_violations parses each .py once and hands the index to all three. (d) dict_key_contracts is split into _contract_scan (each function's _scope_nodes walked once, shared by _module_producers(tree, nodes), _mutated_parameters(node, nodes) and scan['nodes']) and the judge; _scope_index/_build_scope_index memoise per scope (keyed by the scope node) the assigned/added/unknown/calls/reads that _scope_key_sets, _call_sites and the report loop read every round. tools/prove-gates.py row ck3 anchor re-pointed to `normalisers = normalisers | index.get(local, frozenset())`; --list shows every row anchored. PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md ### tools/lints/_deps.py has one new paragraph on the one-walk-per-scope rule. That section held no memo paragraph, so the new paragraph names the memos itself. tests/test__deps.py gains ix1-ix12 and a module-level _CK3_PAIR that ck3 and ix4 share. Equivalence on the live tree, comparing HEAD's module (exec'd from git show) with the new one in one process: config_key_reads (134 keys), config_divergences, config_read_violations, register_citation_violations, _scan_edges_once (749 static/19 runtime), layer_violations, tests_import_violations, dict_key_contracts (296 producers, 1974 reads), dict_key_violations all SAME; the three citation readers compared file by file over 356 tracked .py files (112 hits) gave 0 differences. Each of `prove-gates.py --only config_read_violations | register_citation_violations | dict_key_violations | layer_violations | tests_import_violations` exited 0, with every red row red and every allow row red under over-fire. Block times, before -> after, one run each: dg-config-memo 24.8 -> 12.9 s, dg-config-key 8.5 -> 4.5, dg-citation 18.6 -> 7.4, dg-scan-memo 16.5 -> 8.8, dg-dict-key 13.2 -> 9.1. The 1-minute load average was 4.6-6.0 before and 7.3-10.2 after, so the after runs had the noisier machine. Gates: sweep tests/test__deps.py exit 0 (266 cases); sweep tests/test__output_lints.py + tests/test__refs.py exit 0 (173 + 292 cases); prove-gates --list exit 0; ruff and vermin clean on the changed .py. Dependants: the importers of _deps (_manifest_rules, _manifest_vocab, _doctor_policy, test__manifest_vocab, test__output, test__panel_paths, evals.json, tools/affected.py, tools/sweep-selftests.py) still hold, because only private helpers changed, every public answer is equal on the live tree, and git grep finds no caller of a changed helper outside the task files. tests/test__deps.py's uses of _check_label_citations/_py_docstring_citations keep the text form (rc8-rc14 pass). The _block_accessor and _fault_hits rows in prove-gates are untouched and anchored. PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md dependants: the new paragraph sits inside an existing section, so guide_enumeration is unaffected, and dg-guide passed in the sweep. P152.10's work (one parse per file in _output_lints/prove-gates) was not touched.
outcome.descriptive: The dependency lints now index each scope, module and file once and look facts up; every lint answers exactly as before on the live tree, and the five profiled test__deps blocks run in roughly half the time.

testsAdded: ix1-ix4: per-scope normaliser index equals a per-name recomputation for the module and each function of a fixture whose `name` is trimmed in one function and taken as typed in another; the config scan attributes each read its own scope's normalisers; a poisoned index does not leak into the next build; _name_normalisers answers the ck3 pair

ix5-ix6: per-file loader facts equal the one-question helpers for every file of a fixture with a two-hop borrowed wrapper and a basename collision (one copy binds _loader as L); the runtime edges equal a recomputation and the concrete expected set

ix7-ix9: per-file literal index equals _docstring_constant_ids/_check_label_constant_ids/walk-ordered strings on a fixture with an if-body string, a fault-shaped label and a helper-handed label; each reader answers the same from index and text; register_citation_violations parses each .py once

ix10-ix12: dict-key per-scope index equals a fresh build over each scope's own nodes on a fixture binding `row` in the module, a function and a nested function; a poisoned entry is read for its scope only; the contract scan reports exactly the outer-scope finding carrying only `a`
